title: NECO Financial Accounting Part 2: Partnerships, Companies & the Financial System - Financial Accounting - Inter branch transactions
exam: NECO Financial Accounting Part 2: Partnerships, Companies & the Financial System
subject: Financial Accounting

questions.q: Under instructions from Head Office, Branch A transfers goods valued at ₦15,000 directly to Branch B. In the books of **Branch A**, how should this inter-branch transfer be recorded?
options: Debit Branch B Account; Credit Head Office Account
Debit Head Office Account; Credit Goods Sent/Received (or Branch Stock) Account
Debit Branch B Account; Credit Sales Account
Debit Goods Sent/Received Account; Credit Branch B Account
questions.explain:
Branches do not maintain direct accounts with each other; all inter-branch transfers are routed through the **Head Office Account**.

When Branch A sends goods to Branch B:
*   Branch A is relieving itself of responsibility for those goods by returning the obligation back to Head Office: **Debit Head Office Account** (reducing accountability to HO).
*   **Credit Goods Received/Branch Stock Account** (to reduce stock).
